title: Missa de Sancto Donatiano
description: A Mass by Jacob Obrecht, choirmaster at the church of St. Donatian, written for a Bruges family in 1487. The church, Bruges’s cathedral, stood on the Burg until it was torn down after the French Revolution.

title: Die tote Stadt: Glück, das mir verblieb
description: The best-known aria from “The Dead City,” an opera based on Rodenbach’s Bruges-la-Morte and set in Bruges. Korngold was 23 when it opened, and later wrote film scores in Hollywood.

title: Marieke
description: A song of lost love by Jacques Brel, the Belgian singer, in French with a refrain in Dutch. He sings of the towers of Bruges and Ghent, and of the flat land of Flanders between them.

title: Prologue
description: The opening of Carter Burwell’s score for In Bruges, played over the film’s first shots of the canals and towers. It is quiet and sad, and sets the tone for the film.
